build_DinoTxt_model: build a DinoTxt model with a DinoTxtConfig, vision backbone, and text backbone for vision-language embeddings
encode_image_with_DinoTxt: encode an image tensor into a feature vector using DinoTxt encode_image with optional normalization
encode_text_with_DinoTxt: encode a text token tensor into a feature vector using DinoTxt encode_text with optional normalization
get_image_text_logits: get image-to-text and text-to-image similarity logits using DinoTxt get_logits with normalized features
run_DinoTxt_forward: run the DinoTxt forward pass to get normalized image features, text features, and logit scale
